notes.title: Patch 1.1 Released
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*] Fixed kill/wave count bug on game over screen (will no longer display 0)
[*] Improved load times for title screen (please be patient)[/list]
[b]Game Changes[/b]
[list][*] Reduced spawn rate of all waves by 10%
[*] HP of Chads and Naruto Running Chads has been decreased by 20%
[*] Ammo spawn rate has been increased by 15%
[/list]
